Senior Software Engineer - Backend Platform
NimbusWorks Technologies | Bengaluru, India | Full-time

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team. You will
design, build and operate the backend services that power our customer-facing
products, working closely with product managers and frontend engineers.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and build scalable backend services and RESTful APIs in Python
- Own services end to end, from design review through production deployment
- Model and optimise relational data in PostgreSQL, including query tuning
- Containerise services with Docker and deploy them to AWS
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines so the team can ship safely several times a day
- Write unit and integration tests and take part in code reviews
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical design discussions
- Participate in an on-call rotation and improve monitoring and observability

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
- Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong programming skills in Python
- Solid experience building REST APIs and microservices
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and SQL query optimisation
- Experience with Docker and container based deployment
- Working knowledge of AWS (EC2, S3, IAM)
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git based workflows
- Experience with unit testing and automated test suites

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Kubernetes in production
- Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure as code tooling
- Exposure to Kafka or other event streaming platforms
- Experience with React or another modern frontend framework
- Contributions to open source projects

What we offer
- Competitive compensation and equity
- Flexible hybrid working
- Annual learning and development budget
